testPolicy.text: Official ACT or SAT scores are required to be submitted from the testing agency to complete the application; official Classic Learning Test (CLT) scores also satisfy the requirement. The SAT Essay, ACT Writing and ACT Science are not required.

cost.totalIncludes: Estimated 2026-27 cost of attendance, published as ranges (tuition varies by college and major): tuition + housing and food + transportation + books, course materials, supplies and equipment + personal/miscellaneous. UT's flat-rate tuition includes required fees.

inState.note: resident living on or off campus; CDS G1 2026-27 gives in-district tuition 11,656

aidPromise.text: Texas Advance Commitment: Texas residents with family adjusted gross income up to $100,000 and financial need have tuition covered by gift aid; families with AGI between $100,000 and $125,000 receive tuition support. Applies to tuition only.

deadlines.early: October 15 (Early Action; supplemental materials October 22; decision or deferral by January 15, 2027)
deadlines.regular: December 1 (supplemental materials December 10; decision by February 15, 2027)

facts.text: UT Austin must automatically admit enough Texas students to fill 75 percent of resident spaces; for summer/fall 2027 applicants the automatic-admission threshold is the top 5 percent of a Texas high school class.
For fall 2025 UT admitted 16,828 of 46,879 Texas applicants but only 2,653 of 35,268 out-of-state applicants and 673 of 8,543 international applicants.
Texas families with AGI up to $100,000 and financial need pay no tuition under the Texas Advance Commitment.
An SAT, ACT or CLT score is required to complete the application.
The 2026-27 cost of attendance runs from 32,508 to 35,386 for a Texas resident and from 64,204 to 72,916 for a non-resident, depending on the program.
UT has no waiting list (CDS C2) and no Early Decision; Early Action closes October 15.

notes: Cycle from CDS 2025-26 C1 (45,923 + 44,735 + 32 = 90,690 applied; 8,704 + 11,449 + 1 = 20,154 admitted; 4,097 + 5,803 = 9,900 enrolled, 155 part-time); residency table sums match. The PDF (downloaded from the Box link on reports.utexas.edu) has no values in C9 (test scores), C11-C12 (GPA) or C21-C22 dates in its text layer; C21 ED = No, C22 shows N/A. Cost page publishes ranges, recorded as strings. No official fall 2026 class numbers recorded. Cost ranges are kept in tuitionRange, housingFoodRange and totalRange (strings); the numeric fields are null because UT publishes no single figure.
